_comment: The persistent host's settings (agent-runner skill). Every field has a default; the file may be
absent. port/bind: where the page listens — 127.0.0.1 only until the LAN follow-up (bind 0.0.0.0
plus a token). launchDir: the folder outside the repo every call runs from; null = the sibling
StoryPlanner-fanout beside the repository. maxParallel / utilizationCap: the host's ceilings across
every batch. idleMinutes: a call whose stream has been silent this long is killed and recorded
failed; there is no absolute time limit. All three are adjustable live on the page; changes go to
host-log.txt beside the exe and are not written back here — a different default is an edit to this
file. mapPath: the process map the /map route renders, absolute or relative to the repo root;
null = .claude/skills/v3-buildout/map.md, falling back to v3-buildout-2/map.md until the swap.
